page.overview:
Who is J. Shoesteer?

J. Shoesteer is a character in Cars. He is a supporter of Rust-eze, a medicated bumper ointment trademark that sponsors rookie race car Lightning McQueen.

Lightning tries to sneak by the crowd by hiding behind a sign, but it falls down, revealing him to the crowd, who eagerly greet him. Lightning takes the stage and gives a short speech while Shoesteer and numerous other rusty cars listen admiringly.
